disagreements.a: Seven guides flag a possible missable. [1][4][5][8][9][13][16]
disagreements.b: Push Square knows of none; planetgta6 had no firm answer. [3][2]
disagreements.call: Treat #28 as missable. Meditate on the Chapter 1 balcony; whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed. [1][4][5]

disagreements.a: Several guides estimate about 200 h; sixshore estimates 200–250+ h. [1][4][8][9][5]
disagreements.b: Push Square gives 250+ h and suggests 300 h or more; a reviewer cited by sixshore says well over 100 h. [3][5]
disagreements.call: Use about 200 h for planning, with 250–300 h or more as Push Square’s upper estimate. [1][3][4][8]

disagreements.a: PSN and the wider consensus list Silver. [2][1][4][5][6][7][8][9][11][12][13][14][15][16]
Three guides report 12 ranges with 42 challenges. [1][4][18]
disagreements.b: Push Square names two locations; the 42 challenges are agreed. [3]
disagreements.call: Use 12 ranges and 42 gold medals. Whether this is a difference between venues and individual ranges is unconfirmed. [1][3][4][18]

disagreements.a: PSN and several guides give 28 hidden trophies. [2][4][5][6]
disagreements.b: Push Square leaves Personal Best unmarked. [3][5]

disagreements.a: The PSN line reads “Complete the final mission.” [2]
disagreements.call: Use the official PSN line for #7. [2]

disagreements.a: TrueAchievements-derived lists use varying values by trophy. [2][4][5]
disagreements.b: Of Zen and Computing gives flat 50G Silver and 10G Bronze values. [17]
disagreements.call: Prefer the varying values; this PS5 tracker uses grades. [2][4][5]

disagreements.a: One More Game lists 1P, 3G, 14S and 18B, which add to 36, and calls The Shootist Bronze. [10]
disagreements.call: Use the PSN split and The Shootist’s Silver. [1][2][4]

disagreements.a: GameTrek assigns Chapters 2 and 3 to Paradise Lost and T**s Ass Drug Money. [18]
disagreements.call: Use PSN’s Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 descriptions. [1][2][4]
